sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, at::text AS t, 'ledger' AS b, balance_cents::text AS c, coalesce(residual_cents::text,'-') AS d, coalesce(presumed_transfer::text,'-') AS e, coalesce(fills_counted::text,'-') AS f FROM incentive_balance_observations ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 8) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, max(at)::text, 'evt', kind, count(*)::text, '-', '-' FROM incentive_collector_events WHERE at > now() - interval '90 minutes' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 12) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, o.created_at::text, 'alimm', o.market_ticker, coalesce(o.side,'-'), o.limit_price::text, coalesce(o.status,'-') FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT 4 AS g, p.captured_at::text, 'pos', p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.side,'-'), p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.captured_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND (p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' OR p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES%') ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 6)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
